name: Once Upon a Time in Texas
source: In “Once Upon a Time in Texas,” you play a young man who reunites with his sweetheart after attending college in the city for three years; however, happiness is fleeting, and in tough Texas, threats are always lurking.
translation: 在《德克萨斯往事》中，你扮演一个年轻人，在城里读了三年大学后与心上人重逢；然而，幸福转瞬即逝，在严峻的德克萨斯州，威胁始终潜伏着。
